scene_description: Two children are playing on a colorful wooden playground structure. One child with curly blonde hair wears a plaid shirt and blue shorts and is climbing up. The other child with dark curly hair wears a pink shirt and jeans and is standing on the platform. The playground has green panels, yellow flower decorations, and a brown hexagonal climbing frame.

questions.question: What color is the girl's shirt?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the shirt the girl on the right is wearing.

questions.question: Who is climbing up onto the playground?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the child on the left side of the picture.

questions.question: What color are the panels on the playground?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the flat boards on the side of the playground structure.

questions.question: Where are the two children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big wooden and colorful structure the children are on.

questions.question: What is the boy holding with his hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the boy's hands and what they are grabbing onto.
